findings: OFFLINE F1 (biggest): 113 of 115 named interiors have NO GEOMETRY. engine.js cellFor() maps env.interior to one of five hand-built W1-07 rooms (barge-hold, writ-house, helstrom-market, stormhold-street, rootlands-well) and otherwise returns the generic 'interior' cell, which scene.js builds ONCE via buildHall() — 'a hall lit by one hearth (VP05)'. Every shop, temple, guild hall and house in all eight settlements is the same room.

OFFLINE F2: interior.props / .lights / .containers / .unique_item are read by NOTHING in game/src. bounds_m is read only by populateSettlement to derive an NPC offset. 'hand-furnished' is a list of prop-name strings nobody instantiates.

OFFLINE F3: settlement.buildings is read at exactly two sites — SettlementSystem's door table and a .length count in listSettlements(). No building mesh exists. RI-WLD03 R5 (unique architecture kit, >=8 bespoke meshes, >=1 unique silhouette) has zero implementation. The doors have no buildings.

OFFLINE F4: stepSchedule's own docstring claims it changes 'pos (they walk to the slot's anchor)'. It never touches n.pos. Positions are assigned once in populateSettlement from the slot live AT SPAWN and never re-derived; a person whose 19:00 slot is the inn keeps the offset computed inside their house.

OFFLINE F5: 0 of 347 NPC records carry pos. At 03:00 zero NPCs anywhere are outdoors; at noon 34 of 347 are (and all 34 are the W1-GIVER-PRESENCE posts, a NEIGHBOURING piece's work). The street of every town is empty at every hour of W1-04's own population.

*** HARD FAIL, MEASURED IN THE BROWSER: GOING THROUGH A DOOR DOES NOT CHANGE WHAT IS DRAWN. enterInterior('thorn-hall') sets env.interior and cellFor() returns 'interior', but renderer.cells.province stays the only visible group across 6 steps and a renderFrame. Only a manual E._applyCell() switches it — and _applyCell is called from loadState/census/barge-reset/save-load, NEVER from useDoor/leaveInterior. Worse in the other direction: after exitInterior the visible cell is still 'interior' while the player stands outdoors in Thorn. reports/critic-w1-04-r1b.json.

This is the SAME class of defect the builder found and fixed on the body (sim.player.pos was a mirror). The builder fixed the body half and did not fix the render half, and its own probe cannot see it because tools/world/w1-04-consumption.mjs never reads the renderer.
